values.name: photos
values.source: SPEC-master 5d (FACTS: 'the plug-in shows work photos'); master-A.json live.facts

values.name: documents
values.means: A document to sign or OK on the secure page before the work: a contract, a written estimate, a proposal or a design (the business sending it is its signature; REDESIGN 2).
values.source: master-A.json header facts; live.facts; MC C5 (insurance)

values.name: waitlist
values.means: The business keeps a waitlist for full times (the owner's booking rules turn it on, S1-21).

values.name: tips
values.means: A tip line on the bills Rosie sends (the owner's tip setting in S1-21's "Bills I send" row, or S11-56).

values.name: discounts
values.means: The business takes its own discount codes on the booking page (the owner turns them on in the portal, S11-56). Off: the booking never asks for one. Gift cards are never taken through Rosie.

values.name: stages
values.means: Big jobs paid in stages, each stage billed before the next (the plug-in's or the owner's stage plan).

values.name: monthlybill
values.means: One bill a period for plans or business accounts (the owner turns it on in the portal, S11-56).

values.name: banktransfer
values.means: Big bills may be paid by bank transfer (the owner's setting in S1-21, or S11-56).

values.name: extrawork
values.means: Work can change at the visit: an add-on, a bigger job found, goods or an urgent part (the plug-in's visit rules).

values.name: nomoney
values.means: A whole business with no money through Rosie; a switch and a fact, set both or neither (SPEC-master 5d).

values.name: capacitycheck
values.means: The owner turns it on: at the times they pick, the AI asks how many more a window can take; silence turns that window's new bookings into requests (D87).

values.name: sensitive
values.means: On for health care, therapy, addiction, legal and immigration work, children's services, funeral and grief work, investigators; off: normal texts. The switch grief is merged into it.

values.name: no2
values.means: On for human health practices and law firms; off: the $2 lines. It follows the owner's choice at the $2 split, never set by hand.

values.name: welfare
values.means: On for work where the person served may be unable to answer; off: normal no-show words.

values.name: cancelright
values.means: On for work sold at the customer's place with a written cancel period; off: no cancel period for work already given.
values.source: SPEC-master 5b; master-A.json live.switches; FS row V20

values.name: verify
values.means: License and document checks: off for now (D96; not launched). Off: licenses and documents are optional, shown as the business gave them and never checked.

values.name: nomoney
values.means: A whole business with no money through Rosie; merged into the fact nomoney, and set with it (SPEC-master 5d; K-23 v1 company_kinds_nomoney_fact_and_switch).

values.unset_means: A same-day booking books on the yes, unless another rule asks.
values.means: A same-day booking waits for the owner's OK: the page says 'This is a request' before the yes, and nothing is charged until the OK (A4-98).
values.source: S1-21 ('Same-day and new customers: Ask you first'); FS row H05; A4-98; B4-115

values.unset_means: A new customer's booking books on the yes, unless another rule asks.
values.means: A new customer's booking waits for the owner's OK (A4-98); where it covers a job sent now, the owner gets 5 minutes, any hour, and silence sends nobody (B4-115).
values.source: S1-21 ('Same-day and new customers: Ask you first'); FS row H05; A4-98; B4-115

values.unset_means: No date waits for an OK.
values.means: A booking on these dates waits for the owner's OK; several ranges may be in effect at once.
values.source: A4-98 ('same day, new customers, some services, date ranges'); S1-21 ('some services or dates'); FS row H05

values.unset_means: No notice beyond the times the times card offers.
values.means: A booking needs at least this much notice before its start; a time with less is not offered.
Bookings are offered only on these dates; several ranges add up.
values.source: FS row H08 ('Months offered', O: all year); S1-21 ('Also months offered', kept at default); S11-57

values.means: The least a booking's total may be, with any extra work; a photo quote is checked when priced, and a price set only at the visit or by the hour passes, with a note on the owner's booking card (limit 2).
values.source: arch 06 line 301 (limit 2: 'The $250 minimum'); arch 05 line 239 ('owner rules · minimum job'); C-082

values.unset_means: No cap beyond the price known then (FS row V06).
values.means: The most a deposit may be: a cap the plug-in knows, shown as a suggested row and kept by the owner as the owner's own rule, never Rosie's check.
values.source: S1-21 ('Deposit or fee caps the plug-in knows show as suggested rows. They're the owner's own rules, never Rosie's checks'); S1-03 block 6

values.unset_means: No cap beyond what was paid now, when money was paid now (S1-21).
values.means: The most a late-cancel or no-show fee may be: a cap the plug-in knows, kept by the owner as the owner's own rule, never Rosie's check.
values.source: S1-21 ('Deposit or fee caps the plug-in knows show as suggested rows'); S1-03 block 6; FS row V08

values.means: The business keeps a waitlist for full times (A4-60).
values.source: S1-21 ('Also the waitlist ... all off'); FS row V14; master-A.json header facts (waitlist)

values.means: A tip line on the bills Rosie sends, only where bills are sent.
values.source: S1-21 ('Bills Rosie sends: a tip line'); FS row V11; master-A.json header facts (tips)

values.unset_means: Off: no bill is paid by bank transfer.
values.means: A bill Rosie sends over this amount may be paid by bank transfer.
values.source: S1-21 ('bank transfer over an amount'); FS row V12; master-A.json header facts (banktransfer)

values.means: One bill a period for many visits.
values.source: S1-21 ('one bill for many visits ... all off'); FS row V17; S11-56; master-A.json header facts (monthlybill)

values.means: The no-show count, off unless the owner turns it on: after this many no-shows or late cancels with no card, a card is needed to book.
values.source: S1-21 ('the no-show count, all off'); S11-57 ('The no-show count stays off unless Sam turns it on'); the plug-ins' pf.edges repeatNoShow ('the owner's setting')

values.unset_means: On: bookings from members who pay elsewhere are taken, each class $2 at check-in.
values.means: Take bookings from members who pay elsewhere; off: those bookings are declined (A4-80).
values.source: S1-21 ('take bookings from members who pay elsewhere? On unless Sam turns it off'); A4-80; master-A.json live.merged.facts (memberships: packs)

values.means: Only the business's own customers may book; the booking page says so kindly.
values.source: S1-21 ('Only the business's own customers may book'); FS row K10; A4-43; A4-80

values.means: The owner's own words, which the AI reads and code never enforces; the read-back tells the owner it was saved only as a note.
